examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Five solution areas under a section title and description, every picture at the closing end. Each band carries its own overline; the AI band draws a live `ConsoleMockup` scene, and the performance band links as a whole to its own `href` while its button keeps its own. Under the section title each band headline is an `h3`. Edit the props in the Controls panel — switch `variant` to `alternating`, or clear the `title` to drop the header.

examples.name: Variants
examples.summary: Both layouts stacked: the `media-end` run of solution areas with no header, then the `alternating` run of network claims under its centered header, the pictures swapping sides band by band.

examples.name: Product media
examples.summary: Bands whose pictures show the product itself: a ConsoleMockup console screen (`widget`), which plays its beat while the pointer is over the band, a Diagram request flow (`diagram`), and an object picture set whole on its own plate (`imageFramed`). Widget and diagram load only when a band uses them.

site.name: Solutions
site.summary: The five solution areas of Home: large, centered bands, every picture at the closing end, each with an outlined "Learn more" button.

site.name: Alternating
site.summary: The Our Network run: a centered section title, then four bands alternating the picture between the opening and the closing end.
